200.answer: To return your Wi-Fi pods, visit the Bell equipment return portal to request a prepaid return shipping label. You will need your Internet or TV account number. After submitting the request, you will receive an email with a scannable QR code.

snippets.text: Drop off your package at the shipper listed on your shipping label: Purolator drop-off locations accepting QR codes Purolator drop-off locations accepting preprinted shipping labels You can also arrange a Purolator pick-up by calling the number found on the return label or downloading the Purolator app on your mobile device. Canada Post outlets If you don't have a prepaid shipping label: Visit the Bell equipment return portal to request a prepaid return shipping label. Depending on what you are returning, you will need your Internet and/or TV account number. Refer to the links below for instructions on returning each type of equipment. Internet account number (b1 or b2 number) Fibe or Satellite TV account number Once your request is submitted, you will receive an email with a scannable QR code that acts as your prepaid shipping label. If you have access to a printer, the email also contains a link to print out the shipping label. Package the equipment so that it can be shipped safely (a box is recommended).

snippets.text: I misplaced the prepaid shipping label for returning my phone. How can I get another one? Online: You have two options: A copy of the prepaid shipping label was sent to the email address that you used to submit your return request. Once you find the email, print and use the shipping label to ship your phone. OR Log in to MyBell, Go to the Overview or Device page, and select Track my device return request. Once you have logged in, select Print pre-paid shipping label and use it to ship your phone. Important: if you have recently purchased a new device, please do not use the return shipping label that was included in the box.

requestBody.query: how many days it will take for the return to be credited?

200.answer: It can take between 1 to 2 bill cycles from the date you returned the equipment to receive the credit. It takes approximately 7-10 days for your package to arrive at the warehouse and be processed.

snippets.text: Please note it can take 7-10 days from the time you sent your package for items to arrive at our warehouse and to be processed. If you were billed equipment non-return fees, it can take 1-2 bill cycles for the return to be credited and to appear on your bill.
snippets.title: How do Bell equipment returns and refunds work?

snippets.text: TV: The refund balance for a TV service is held for 60 days (2 billing cycles) following the final bill, as other charges may apply (video on demand, pay-per-view, etc.) Internet and Home phone: The refund balance for a Home phone or Internet service is held for 30 days (1 billing cycle) following the final bill, as other charges may apply (usage, long distance charges, etc.) Billing refunds Non-return fee credit: If you have returned rented equipment after being charged the non-return fee, it takes up to two billing cycles from the date you returned the equipment to receive the credit. Final bill balances: For balances between $10 and $500 on your final bill, we will mail a cheque to your mailing address on file within 90 days of the date of that bill. For balances of a different amount, please contact us to request that a cheque be mailed.
